theorems.name: Submission.codim1_ldr_pushforward_massOn_le_first_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (X : Euclid P → Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen W → R.measure W ≠ ∞ → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → (∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ t)) → (∀ t x, x ∉ tsupport X → φ t x = x) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ → ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x - ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - t • fderiv ℝ X x‖ ≤ ε * |t|) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ → ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (φ t x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (φ t) x)) ∂μHE[n]) → S.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((R.measure W).toReal + t * R.firstVariation X + ε * |t|)
